children: Farmland Partners Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $9.8M, down 13.1% from $11.3M a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to the Company of $15.4M, compared with net income of $483K in the prior-year quarter. Diluted loss per share was $0.36.
Revenue was $9.8M, compared with $11.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (13.1%).
Net loss attributable to the Company was $15.4M, compared with net income of $483K in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was $(0.36), compared with $0.00 in the prior-year quarter.
The company owned 69,987 acres across 11 states as of September 30, with about 60% in primary crops and 40% in specialty crops.
Nine-month revenue declined 7% year over year as lower rental income and crop sales following asset sales outweighed growth in loan interest and royalties.
Nine-month crop sales fell 43%, reflecting the sale of a walnut farm and lower citrus prices and yields.
Loan balances and interest income grew, while updated credit assumptions increased the provision for loan losses.
Farmland Partners continued selective property sales and expects to pursue acquisitions and dispositions that support risk-adjusted returns.
